datasets.name: ds_run_context
queryLines: SELECT model_name, model_version, model_type, horizon_days, primary_objective, temporal_posture, scoring_run_id, as_of_date, project_name, project_run_id FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_run_context')) ORDER BY as_of_date DESC LIMIT 1

datasets.name: ds_account_drivers
queryLines: WITH src AS (  SELECT entity_id, account_top_shap_features   FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_account_explanation'))   WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_entity, '') IN ('', 'None') OR entity_id = :selected_entity)) SELECT entity_id,        d.feature AS feature,        d.shap_contribution AS contribution,        d.value AS feature_value,        d.direction AS direction,        ABS(d.shap_contribution) AS abs_contribution FROM src LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(account_top_shap_features) AS d WHERE d.feature IS NOT NULL ORDER BY abs_contribution DESC

datasets.name: ds_eligibility_rules
queryLines: SELECT playbook_id, playbook_name,        eligibility_rules_prose AS rule,        eligibility_rules_sql AS rule_sql,        expected_uplift_pct,        rationale FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_playbook_eligibility_rules')) WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None') OR playbook_name = :selected_playbook) ORDER BY playbook_name

datasets.name: ds_portfolio_matrix
queryLines: SELECT playbook_id, playbook_name, risk_tier, eligible_count, recommended_count, holdout_count, suppressed_count, total_value_at_risk, mean_churn_probability FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_portfolio_risk_matrix'))

datasets.name: ds_portfolio_totals
queryLines: SELECT SUM(eligible_count) AS total_eligible, SUM(recommended_count) AS total_recommended, SUM(total_value_at_risk) AS total_value_at_risk, COUNT(DISTINCT playbook_id) AS active_playbooks FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_portfolio_risk_matrix')) WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None') OR playbook_name = :selected_playbook) AND (COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') IN ('', 'None') OR risk_tier = :selected_risk_tier)

datasets.name: ds_scope_indicator
queryLines: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None')    AND COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') IN ('', 'None')    THEN 'Full portfolio (no filter)'    ELSE CONCAT(     CASE WHEN COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') NOT IN ('', 'None') THEN CONCAT('Playbook: ', :selected_playbook) ELSE 'All playbooks' END,      '  •  ',      CASE WHEN COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') NOT IN ('', 'None') THEN CONCAT('Risk tier: ', :selected_risk_tier) ELSE 'All risk tiers' END   ) END AS scope_label

datasets.name: ds_playbook_archetypes
queryLines: SELECT playbook_id, playbook_name, archetype_id, archetype_name, risk_tier, account_count, recommended_count, mean_churn_probability, total_value_at_risk FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_playbook_archetype_rollup')) WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None') OR playbook_name = :selected_playbook) AND (COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') IN ('', 'None') OR risk_tier = :selected_risk_tier) ORDER BY total_value_at_risk DESC

datasets.name: ds_accounts
queryLines: SELECT entity_id, playbook_name, archetype_name, risk_tier, churn_probability, value_at_risk, expected_loss, policy_rank_among_eligible, eligible_playbook_count, eligibility_evidence, recommended, is_holdout FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_eligible_all_playbooks')) WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None') OR playbook_name = :selected_playbook) AND (COALESCE(:selected_archetype, '') IN ('', 'None') OR archetype_name = :selected_archetype) AND (COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') IN ('', 'None') OR risk_tier = :selected_risk_tier) ORDER BY expected_loss DESC LIMIT 500

datasets.name: ds_account_detail
queryLines: SELECT entity_id, playbook_name, playbook_description, archetype_name, archetype_description, archetype_rationale, archetype_mean_churn_probability, archetype_cluster_size, CAST(archetype_feature_thresholds AS STRING) AS archetype_feature_thresholds, risk_tier, churn_probability, value_at_risk, expected_loss, eligibility_evidence, policy_rank_among_eligible, eligible_playbook_count, eligibility_rules_sql, expected_uplift_pct, policy_rationale, recommended, is_holdout FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_account_explanation')) WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_entity, '') IN ('', 'None') OR entity_id = :selected_entity) ORDER BY policy_rank_among_eligible ASC LIMIT 1

datasets.name: ds_run_history
queryLines: SELECT scoring_run_id, as_of_date, model_name, model_version, decision_policy_id, total_eligible_rows, distinct_entities, distinct_archetypes, distinct_playbooks, recommended_rows, holdout_rows, suppressed_rows, mean_churn_probability FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_run_anchor_history')) ORDER BY as_of_date DESC

datasets.name: ds_filter_playbooks
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT playbook_name FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_portfolio_risk_matrix')) WHERE playbook_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY playbook_name

datasets.name: ds_filter_risk_tiers
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT risk_tier FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_portfolio_risk_matrix')) WHERE risk_tier IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE risk_tier WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

datasets.name: ds_filter_archetypes
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT archetype_name FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_playbook_archetype_rollup')) WHERE archetype_name IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None') OR playbook_name = :selected_playbook) AND (COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') IN ('', 'None') OR risk_tier = :selected_risk_tier) ORDER BY archetype_name

datasets.name: ds_filter_entities
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT entity_id, expected_loss FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_eligible_all_playbooks')) WHERE entity_id IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(:selected_playbook, '') IN ('', 'None') OR playbook_name = :selected_playbook) AND (COALESCE(:selected_archetype, '') IN ('', 'None') OR archetype_name = :selected_archetype) AND (COALESCE(:selected_risk_tier, '') IN ('', 'None') OR risk_tier = :selected_risk_tier) ORDER BY expected_loss DESC LIMIT 1000

datasets.name: ds_account_narrative
queryLines: WITH src AS (  SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(concat(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.v_account_explanation'))   WHERE (COALESCE(:selected_entity, '') IN ('', 'None') OR entity_id = :selected_entity)   ORDER BY policy_rank_among_eligible ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT label, content, sort_order FROM (  SELECT 'Playbook'                  AS label, CAST(playbook_name AS STRING)          AS content, 1 AS sort_order FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Playbook description', CAST(playbook_description AS STRING),                 2 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Archetype',            CAST(archetype_name AS STRING),                       3 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Archetype description',CAST(archetype_description AS STRING),                4 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Archetype rationale',  CAST(archetype_rationale AS STRING),                  5 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Feature thresholds',   CAST(archetype_feature_thresholds AS STRING),         6 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Eligibility evidence', CAST(eligibility_evidence AS STRING),                 7 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Eligibility predicate (SQL)', CAST(eligibility_rules_sql AS STRING),         8 FROM src   UNION ALL SELECT 'Policy rationale',     CAST(policy_rationale AS STRING),                     9 FROM src) ORDER BY sort_order
